title: Evening Courses at Millbrook Community Centre

passage.title: Millbrook Community Centre: Autumn Evening Courses
passage.subtitle: Courses run for ten weeks from the second week of September. Book at reception or on our website.

paragraphs.label: A
paragraphs.text: Beginners' Spanish. Learn the basics of everyday conversation, from ordering food to asking for directions. Our tutor, who grew up in Valencia, uses games and role-plays rather than textbooks, so you will be speaking from the very first lesson. No previous knowledge is needed. Tuesdays, 7–9 pm. £85 for the full course. Please bring a notebook; all other materials are provided.

paragraphs.label: B
paragraphs.text: Digital Photography. Get more out of your camera, whether it is an expensive digital model or the one on your phone. The course covers lighting, composition and simple editing. Two sessions take place outdoors, so warm clothing is recommended. Participants must bring their own camera or smartphone. Wednesdays, 6.30–8.30 pm. £95. At the end of the course, students' best images will be displayed in the centre's café for a month.

paragraphs.label: C
paragraphs.text: Home Repairs for Everyone. Fix a dripping tap, hang a shelf safely and deal with small electrical problems such as changing a plug. All tools are supplied, and safety glasses must be worn at all times in the workshop. Numbers are limited to eight people per group so that everyone gets individual attention. Thursdays, 7–9 pm. £110, which includes a basic toolkit that you can take home at the end of the course.

paragraphs.label: D
paragraphs.text: Cooking on a Budget. Discover how to prepare healthy, tasty meals for under £2 a portion. Each week you will cook a complete dish and take it home to share, so please bring a container with a lid. Recipes are suitable for vegetarians, and other dietary needs can be catered for if you let us know when booking. Mondays, 6–8 pm. £120, including all ingredients.

paragraphs.label: E
paragraphs.text: Creative Writing. Whether you dream of writing a novel or simply want to record family stories, this friendly group will help you find your voice. Each week includes short exercises and an opportunity to share your work, although nobody is ever required to read aloud. The course is led by a local author whose first novel was published last year. Mondays, 7.30–9.30 pm. £75.

paragraphs.label: F
paragraphs.text: Yoga for Stress Relief. Gentle stretching and breathing techniques suitable for all ages and fitness levels. Please wear loose clothing and bring a mat if you have one; a small number are available to borrow. If you have a back or joint problem, you are advised to speak to your doctor before joining. Fridays, 6–7 pm. £60. Those who attend all ten sessions receive a free pass for one week at the centre's gym.

paragraphs.label: G
paragraphs.text: Booking and payment. Courses must be paid for in full at the time of booking. A 15 per cent discount is available to people aged over 65 and to full-time students on production of a valid card. If a course is cancelled because too few people have enrolled, you will receive a full refund. Refunds cannot be given if you decide to leave a course after the second week.
